question: What is the keyboard shortcut for inserting a new slide into an MS-PowerPoint presentation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + M**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The keyboard shortcut for inserting a new slide in MS-PowerPoint is **Ctrl + M**.
 
• Using keyboard shortcuts can enhance productivity and efficiency while working on presentations.
 
• MS-PowerPoint provides various keyboard shortcuts for different functions, which can be customized if needed.
 
• Remembering common shortcuts like **Ctrl + M** for new slides can save time during the creation process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ctrl + X** is used for cutting the selected content.
 
• **Ctrl + S** is used for saving the current presentation.
 
• **Ctrl + N** is used for creating a new presentation.
 
• Keyboard shortcuts are designed to streamline tasks and minimize the use of a mouse for frequent actions.
 
• Learning and utilizing shortcuts can significantly improve workflow efficiency in MS-PowerPoint and other software applications.
